prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, the reference product photograph of a futuristic biomimetic running shoe (Picture 1) is fully referenced as the first frame.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Static black frame. A faint white crosshair and thin white bounding rectangle draw into center; subtle film grain and a soft horizontal scan line drift across the screen. [Shot 2] At 00:00.500, cut to a hard-edged silhouette of the shoe against pure black, identical in profile, scale, and three-quarter pose to Picture 1. The shoe retains its mint-teal knit upper, white textured foam midsole, and dark rubber outsole at this single beat as a clean photographic object suspended in front of black. A thin white measurement bracket and three small crosshair markers appear around toe, midfoot, heel. [Shot 3] At 00:02.000, push in toward the lateral midfoot. Surface desaturates to a B&W macro of the knit upper. Threads, hexagonal perforations, woven texture appear in monochrome close-up. A thin white HUD ring orbits the focal area with a short measurement scale along the lower edge. [Shot 4] At 00:03.500, dolly laterally across the shoe in monochrome. A bright white HUD scanning grid sweeps from heel to toe, projecting thin contour lines, dotted markers, and a faint horizontal cross-section plane through the midsole foam. Each structural layer (outsole, midsole, heel counter, knit upper, cage) is briefly highlighted by a thin white outline. [Shot 5] At 00:04.500, hold a static three-quarter view. The shoe separates vertically into four thin floating layers — dark rubber outsole, white foam midsole, structural heel cage, knit upper — each hovering slightly above the next with a thin white shadow line, all monochrome. Two thin white measurement arrows from a side HUD bracket indicate layer thickness. [Shot 6] At 00:05.500, pull back and rotate slowly to a higher three-quarter angle. The four floating layers push outward into a wider exploded view, drifting apart along the vertical axis while remaining aligned to the original pose. A thin white isometric wireframe of the shoe's negative space appears between layers; four white trajectory lines extend downward from each layer into a faint ground grid. The foam midsole transitions into a biomimetic micro-structure: thousands of small white hexagonal cells populate the midsole from heel to forefoot, then dissolve back into smooth sculpted foam. Monochrome white-on-black with soft inner glow; silhouette and pose of the shoe stay recognizable. [Shot 7] At 00:07.000, cut to a full-frame blueprint wireframe of the shoe in white-on-black line art, matching the original three-quarter pose. Contour lines, lacing pattern, midsole grooves, and outsole tread drawn as thin strokes. Wireframe rotates ten degrees around the vertical axis and back. No labels or text. [Shot 8] At 00:07.500, hold a static three-quarter view. Small white particles converge from the four edges toward center, gradually reconstructing the silhouette of the shoe. As particles settle, the mint-teal knit color fades back into the upper, and the white foam midsole, dark outsole, and structural cage re-materialize, settling into the exact suspended pose of Picture 1. [Shot 9] At 00:08.500, rapid one-second recap: three flash cuts — brief silhouette outline, brief knit weave macro, brief exploded-layer view — each held roughly a third of a second against black with a thin frame border. [Shot 10] At 00:09.000, cut to the final hero lockup. The shoe is suspended in the original three-quarter pose from Picture 1, fully rendered with mint-teal knit upper, white foam midsole, dark outsole, and structural cage, against a soft gradient from deep charcoal at top to lighter charcoal at bottom. A thin white measurement bracket to the lower left, small crosshair to the upper right. The shoe holds this pose with subtle floating micro-motion until the end.
